Implement jmespath.queries.QuerySet(queries,*,options=None,errors="raise") and frozen QueryResult (status,value,error_type,error,phase). Compile the ordered name->expression mapping once via BoundExpression; raise is default, collect preserves individual compile/evaluate JMESPath errors while other queries continue. search(data) returns ordered name->result with phase compile/evaluate/complete and status error/passed. Do not capture unrelated programmer exceptions or retain traceback objects. Query and result-container mutations must not change later searches; standard null remains a successful None value. Use completed variadic validation and literal/option binding for reliable repeated evaluation.

Implement jmespath.streaming.iter_search(expression,documents,*,options=None,errors="raise"). Compile/bind once before consuming first document and yield one result per consumed document without prefetching. Default returns raw standard values; collect returns (zero_based_index,QueryResult) for each success or JMESPath evaluation error using the completed result schema. Syntax errors always raise before input consumption, source/programmer errors propagate, stopping/closing iteration reads no further documents, and independent literal results remain detached. Never materialize whole streams.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_jm_iter_dev.py and concise English compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-jm-iter-dev.md.
